Lina_CS: FYI ShopFront (dedicated, na-south) reporting cascading placement failures + elevated latency since 14:02 UTC. Customers seeing repeated 503s and a bunch of allocations denied. They say it started after a big batch job kicked off.
AlexKim: Can you paste the error logs / request IDs we can trace?
Lina_CS: Pasting trimmed logs from their repro run: ```
  time=2026-03-17T14:02:11Z level=error svc=placement msg=alloc_denied tenant=shopfront reason=GPU_stockout code=ALLOC_DENIED
  time=2026-03-17T14:02:12Z level=warn svc=handler msg=retrying request_id=req_0a3f2 status=503
  time=2026-03-17T14:02:15Z level=error svc=auth msg=token_refresh failed_for=shopfront code=401
```
AlexKim: thanks. Those `ALLOC_DENIED` lines look like placement couldn't find capacity. RonInfra can you check na-south pools and autoscaler?
RonInfra: Looking now — cluster autoscaler shows ASG na-south-gpu at cap 12/12, scale-up attempts 3x in last 5m, but provider quota prevents new instances. GPU utilization: avg=92% across pool, one tenant `ml-batch-prod` is spiking to 85% of GPUs.
JamesO: Noted. Immediate mitigations: (1) route ShopFront to fallback region (na-east) for critical traffic, (2) enable tenant-level throttling for ShopFront to prevent retry storms, (3) open billing ticket for their spike. I'll drive.
EvieOps: I can push a routing override. Command to run: `redwood route override set --tenant shopfront --prefer-region na-east --timeout 30s` — want approval before doing live cutover.
AlexKim: +1 to reroute, but coordinate with sales/CS. Also let's gather a short repro that causes the allocation pattern so we can test the fix.
RonInfra: Additional context: noisy neighbor `ml-batch-prod` started dozens of long-lived sessions after a cron job at 13:58. We've seen more KV cache misses and increased KV allocation retention. Suggest immediate cap: `tenant.concurrency.max=40` for ml-batch-prod.
Lina_CS: Customer also reports a billing spike due to retries (many 503 retries). They sent screenshots. Can we flag for credit pending investigation?
JamesO: Yes — open a billing escalation and tag `priority:high`. Lina_CS, please attach the logs and the timeframe. I'll mark for manual credit review.
EvieOps: Running the routing override now (will route only new requests; existing sessions stick). Command output: ```
  > redwood route override set --tenant shopfront --prefer-region na-east --timeout 30s
  status: accepted
  change_id: ch_20260317_fallback_v1
```
DeployBot: patch/fast-fallback-v1 promoted to prod: routing override applied to tenant=shopfront by EvieOps — CI passed, no rollout blockers.
RonInfra: After override, observed 30% drop in placement failures for shopfront in the next 2m. However underlying na-south capacity problem remains — provider quota must be increased or we rebalance reserved pool.
AlexKim: Agreed. Long-term: (a) increase reserved pool for na-south by 8 GPUs, (b) add autoscaler safeguard: if placement_failure_rate > 5% for 2m then trigger fast-fallback routing automatically, (c) enforce stricter per-tenant concurrency caps for batch workloads.
JamesO: I'll create follow-up tickets: INFRA-4723 (quota request + reserved pool), OPS-8891 (autoscaler fast-fallback), and CS-3145 (customer credit & postmortem). Lina_CS, please update customer that we've routed them and are investigating root cause.
Lina_CS: Will do. I'll confirm with ShopFront within 10m and capture exact repro steps they ran. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
EvieOps: once we have repro, we should run it in staging with capacity-limited cluster to validate the autoscaler/safeguard rules.
RonInfra: One more note — there's a placement policy tweak merged 2 hours ago that relaxed eviction thresholds; rolling it back may reduce churn. Recommend reverting until autoscaler fixes land.
AlexKim: Go ahead and revert the placement-policy change if it's low-risk. EvieOps / RonInfra, coordinate and call it when done.
Lina_CS: Customer confirmed reduced 503s after failover. I'll keep thread open until all follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
